note: Drafted by the builder on 26 October 2026 from the section titles of Forskrift om utførelse av arbeid (English version on arbeidstilsynet.no), the UK HSE page on cement, and the usual sections of a safety data sheet. Formwork, the concrete pump and reversing trucks have no paragraph that the builder could find and check, and are marked as firm practice. The products are synthetic examples. No technical reviewer has checked any of it yet.
